summary: Verified footer session-aware fix end-to-end on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). Visitor footer shows recruit links (footer-apply-link, footer-track-link) and NO council links. Logged-in captain footer shows council links (footer-council-register, footer-council-messages) and NO recruit links — verified on both /admin and /suivi, FR and EN. Deep link /admin#messagerie from footer (while already logged in on /suivi) opens the admin page with MESSAGERIE tab active (border-gold + text-gold + bg-gold/10). Session-expired flow: clicking into /admin#messagerie as a visitor shows the login screen (Coffre), and after login the Messagerie tab is correctly opened via the useEffect watching 'authed' + hash. Logout (REFERMER LE COFFRE) immediately swaps the footer back to visitor without a page reload — gp-auth-changed event works. All text translations correct in FR and EN.
critical_code_review_comments: useAdminSession performs a /auth/me request on every pathname change — fine today, but could be debounced if the app grows. Current anti-brute-force protects it.
Admin.jsx has its own /auth/me call in addition to useAdminSession (via Footer). Minor duplication, not a bug — the pages need the authed boolean locally.
